name: Thiocolchicoside
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Thiocolchicoside is a muscle relaxant whose metabolite (3-demethylthiocolchicine) caused aneuploidy in preclinical studies, so the European Medicines Agency restricted it in 2014 to short courses in adults and adolescents 16 years and older. The European review gives no kidney-impairment dosing. It has no US FDA label.
kidney_function_basis: The EMA review does not address kidney impairment; bands shown on creatinine clearance (CrCl).

bands.recommendation: Oral: maximum 8 mg every 12 hours for no more than 7 consecutive days. Intramuscular: maximum 4 mg every 12 hours for up to 5 days (EMA 2014).
The EMA review gives no kidney dosing, and no kidney pharmacokinetic data were retrieved. Use with caution and specialist judgment.
